note: P21 (box on the MTP (Amendment) Act, 2017) is a short, self-contained passage on one specific named legal topic sitting apart from the surrounding narrative on MTP reasons/safety, so it was given its own subtopic (ST11) rather than folded into the general MTP subtopic. Structural, non-testable passages with no independent content of their own (chapter title page P01, table-of-contents box P02, and the exercises block P35) were bundled into ST1 since they have no better-fitting subtopic. Summary passages (P29-P34) were distributed into the subtopic matching the concept they recap rather than treated as a separate subtopic, since they restate content already covered in-chapter.
